claims.summary: For every odd prime p, n>=5, d>=n-2, h=2^(n-2) and P=p^e>2h-2, if the original generic V_(n-1,d) and V_(n-1,d-1) are normal and 2d=n-2 mod P, then V_(n,d) is normal. The exact joint leading factor H_s^(h), 2s=h(2d-n+2), is 1 mod p after p-local cancellation. Consequently, for P_p the least p-power >126, the original dimension-eight series is normal in every field of characteristic p for all d=3+t*P_p, t>=1, with dimension128d-320; at p3 these are all d=3+243t. No assertion for other degree classes, unconditional arbitrary dimension, or pre-stable thresholds.
